0022600137.text: The New York Knicks, 1-3 and 12th in the East, visit the 1-3 Chicago Bulls, who are 11th in the East and have lost their last two games, while both teams sit 2 games back in their divisions and New York is coming off a win. Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-96 win in New York on April 3, 2026.
